description: Zoho CRM is a cloud CRM platform with a public developer API and MCP servers.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code grant via a connected application (client ID and secret); access tokens last one hour, refresh tokens until revoked.
gate_detail: A Zoho CRM account with appropriate user permissions is needed; a freemium edition (up to 3 users) and a free trial exist. Sources do not state whether free edition API access is limited. No sandbox described.
api_scope: Zoho CRM API (V8) over CRM resources such as Leads, Contacts and Deals, with scoped OAuth permissions for modules, settings, users and org.
mcp_notes: Four Zoho-published MCP servers (data insights, data operations, module customization, workflow automation); OAuth login; MCP calls consume API credits.
blocker_detail: No approval gate shown; API credit limits apply and free-edition API availability is unconfirmed.

evidence.quote: The Zoho CRM API uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication.
The consumer key generated from the connected application.
A Zoho CRM account with appropriate user permissions.
Zoho CRM's freemium edition supports up to 3 users
Zoho CRM MCP servers connect your AI tools to Zoho CRM using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
API calls executed through MCP consume API credits in the same way as standard API calls.

uncertainties: Whether the freemium or trial edition includes API access is not stated.
API style (REST) is not explicitly labeled for the CRM API in the sources.
Webhooks and sandbox are not covered by the sources.
MCP server URL is not stated, only the product page.
